LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.Label: Surface
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.Desc: Blow the ballast and rise to the open sea above. The hull floats on the sea surface map of this tile; dive again from the helm.\n\nThe submarine must be stopped, under open water without ice. From deeper down it first rises to the shallows (an hour per tier, longer with too little ballast) and surfaces when it gets there.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.InFlight: The submarine is under way. Stop first.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.Land: There is land above, not sea.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.Shelf: There is an ice shelf above: hundreds of metres of ice that no submarine can break.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.Iced: The sea above is frozen ({0} m of ice). Use ice-breaking surfacing.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.NoRoom: There is no room for the hull at {0}.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.LetterText: {0} blew its ballast and broke the surface. The hull is riding the open sea.\n\nDive again from the helm when you are ready.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.DiveDesc: Flood the ballast and sink back into the ocean below, then on down to the chosen depth. Everything on the hull goes with it; whatever is off the hull stays behind.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.NotSurfaced: The submarine is not on the surface.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.NotOnHull: The helm is not on a hull held by keel frames.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.NoSeaBelow: There is no free, navigable ocean below.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.Dived: {0} slipped beneath the surface and is resting in the shallows.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.Label: Break through ice
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.Desc: Hover up against the ice for an hour, then blow the main ballast and try to punch through.\n\nWhether it works depends on the ice thickness and temperature against the size of the hull (bigger hulls have more lift). If the ice only cracks, try again within a day: cracked ice gives way more easily. Every attempt damages the ice-breaker frames and needs six hours to reflood and recharge.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.Cooldown: Reflooding and recharging the ballast: {0} left.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.NoIce: There is no ice above. Surface normally.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.TooThick: The ice is {0} m thick, more than the ice-breaker frame can take ({1} m).
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.Hovering: Hovering under the ice, about to break through.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.Begin: {0} is rising slowly against the ice. It will blow its ballast in an hour.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.CancelledMoved: the submarine moved or changed depth.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.CancelDesc: Call off the ice breach. The ballast blows in {0}.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.InspectHovering: Hovering under the ice: breaking through in {0}
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.StuckText: {0} slammed into the ice ({1} m thick) and could not move it (lift ratio {2}). The ice-breaker frames took the blow.\n\nFind thinner ice, a lead, or a bigger hull.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.PartialText: {0} cracked the ice ({1} m thick) but did not break through (lift ratio {2}). The ice-breaker frames are damaged.\n\nTry again within a day, once the ballast is recharged in six hours: the cracked ice will give way more easily.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.SurfacedText: {0} punched up through {1} m of sea ice (lift ratio {2}) and is resting in the hole it broke.\n\nThe open water around the hull freezes over again. Dive before the ice around the hull grows thicker than 0.4 m, or use the ice-breaker frame to break free.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.Violent: The hull burst through so hard that the ice shattered far around it.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.FrozenIn: The hull is frozen in ({0} m of ice around it, more than {1} m). Break free with the ice-breaker frame.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.NotFrozen: The hull is not frozen in.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.BreakFreeDesc: Ram the ice around the hull with the ice-breaker frames until it is open water again. The frames share {0} damage.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.BrokeFree: The ice around the hull is broken open.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.NeedsRoof: Must be under a roof: the frame braces the cabin roof.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.MeasureDesc: Sound the ice above with the upward sonar and estimate whether the submarine can break through.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.MeasureText:
Ice above: {0}, {1} m thick{2}.
Air temperature: {3} °C (flexural strength {4} MPa).
Hull: {5} cells.

Estimated lift ratio: {6} → {7}
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.Result.TooThick: too thick for the ice-breaker frame
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceBreach.Result.Partial: the ice will crack but not break
LanguageData.DepthRim.Ballast.None: There are no ballast tanks on this hull: it cannot dive.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Ballast.Inspect: Ballast: {0} tanks, lifting {1} of {2} hull cells.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Ballast.InspectShort: Not enough: depth changes take {0}x as long.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dive.DeckOccupied: Get everyone off the open deck first: {0}.
LanguageData.DepthRim.HullWarn.Title: Hull not rated for this depth
LanguageData.DepthRim.HullWarn.Text:
Target depth: {0} Hull rating: {1} (weakest piece: {2}) Over by {3} tier(s).
The outward walls will be crushed bit by bit: the weakest loses about {4} HP a day. Once they break, the sea comes in.
Dive anyway?
LanguageData.DepthRim.HullWarn.AlertDesc: These submarines are deeper than their hull is rated for. Their outward walls are being crushed; rise or rebuild them with stronger walls.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.Ascending: {0} is rising from the {1} and will surface once it reaches the shallows.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Surface.AscendBlocked: {0} reached the shallows but cannot surface: {1}
LanguageData.DepthRim.Launch.Label: Launch
LanguageData.DepthRim.Launch.Desc: Take the ship out of the bay onto the open sea next to the colony. The whole hull held by the keel frames goes, with everyone and everything on it; the bay returns to open water.\n\nTo come back, sail to the sea next to the colony and use Dock on the helm.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Launch.NotInPort: The ship is not in a coastal colony.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Launch.NoSea: There is no open sea next to the colony to sail out to (land, or sea ice).
LanguageData.DepthRim.Launch.LetterText: The ship has left the bay and is now floating at {0}.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.StopDesc: Stop the ship where it is now. If there is already a sea site here, the ship moors at it.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.NotAtSea: The ship is not floating on the open sea.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.AlreadyUnderWay: The ship is already under way.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.NoCharge: The batteries aboard cannot run the thrusters for a single tile.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.NotSurface: Pick a tile on the surface.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.NotOpenSea: Not open sea (land or sea ice).
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.OutOfRange: Too far: {0} tiles, the batteries last {1}.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.RetractingGangway: Retracting the gangway; the ship sails once it is in.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.GangwayStuck: The gangway could not be retracted: the ship stays.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.Departed: {0} is under way: {1} tiles to go.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.BlockedAhead: {0}: the sea ahead has frozen over. The ship stops here.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.ArrivedNoRoom: {0} stopped next to {1}: there is no room to moor there.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.ArrivedChooseBerth: {0} has arrived at {1}. Choose where to moor.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.InspectUnderWay: Under way: {0} tiles to go, thrust {1}
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sail.InspectStalled: Drifting: no thrust ({0} tiles to go)
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.LowerDesc: Lower the diving bell straight down to the seabed below. Whoever and whatever is in the bell steps out at the bottom. The winch only turns while the davit has power.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.RaiseDesc: Haul the bell back up to the davit. Only those who have climbed into the bell come up; anyone still out on the seabed stays there.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.AbandonDesc: Cut the bell loose. While it is still being lowered, this just stops and lets everyone out. Once it is on the seabed, the bell and anyone down there are left behind with no air supply.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.AbandonConfirm: Abandon the diving bell? If it is on the seabed, the bell and anyone down there are left behind with no air supply and no way back up.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.UnloadDesc: Let everyone and everything out of the bell here.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.AirReserve: Air: no supply, reserve lasts about {0}
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.Lost: Cut loose: no davit is holding this bell.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.InPort: No sea below: a harbour sits on land. Take the ship out to sea to lower the bell.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.NotAtSea: The davit is not on a ship at sea or a submarine.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.NoSeaBelow: There is no sea below here.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.NoBell: No diving bell within {0} cells of the davit.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.NotDeployed: The bell is not on the seabed.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.Lowering: Lowering the bell: about {0} with power.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.Raising: Raising the bell: about {0} with power.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.PeopleLeftBelow: {0} colonists are still out on the seabed and will stay there.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.Destroyed: The diving bell has been destroyed.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.NoLandingSpot: There is nowhere on the seabed below for the bell to settle.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.Landed: The diving bell has reached the seabed.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.NoStowRoom: No room beside the davit to set the bell down: clear the deck.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.Stowed: The diving bell is back on deck.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.LostText: The diving bell has been cut loose on the seabed. Nobody above is feeding it air any more, and it cannot be raised. Another ship or submarine above the same spot can lower its own bell or anchor to reach anyone down there.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.DavitPlacement: Must be built on a ship's deck or a moon pool.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Bell.NotStowed: The diving bell is not back on deck.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.NoColony: None of your coastal colonies is next to this tile.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.Label: Choose berth
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.Desc: Choose where the ship berths in the colony's waters and which way it faces. The ship comes in from the open sea on its own.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.NotWater: Not open water the hull can float on.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.CannotTurn: {0} ({1}x{2}) cannot be turned a quarter turn.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.NoTurningRoom: No room near the berth to turn the ship.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.NoRoute: No water route wide enough for the ship from the open sea.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.GangwayWontReach: No gangway will reach the shore from here: nobody can walk on or off.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.CannotRotate: The ship could not be turned to that heading.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.NoGangwayAshore: No gangway reaches the shore: build one on the deck facing land to walk on and off.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.ArrivedOffColony: {0} is off {1}. Use Dock on the helm to choose a berth.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Dock.Cancelled: Docking cancelled: {0} waits in the sea off {1}.
